Chapter 573: Chapter 17: Mother Goddess Of Lust (Please Subscribe)_2

Chapter 573: Chapter 17: Mother Goddess of Lust (Please Subscribe)_2

This means that with Lin Yuan’s current strength, he could already be considered invincible among mortals.

“It’s still not enough. Although the gods won’t appear in the mortal realm, that doesn’t mean they can’t descend into it, they are simply restricted by the twenty-four most powerful Prime Gods. I still need to cultivate quietly and keep a low profile until I return to the Ninth Rank, then I will fear nothing.”

Lin Yuan thought to himself.

This return to the Eighth Layer held no suspense for Lin Yuan,

The only surprise was the awakening of his Physical Body Divine Ability.

The Elemental Body.

...

Capable of being immune to ninety percent of all elemental attacks at the same realm.

The so-called elements are the interpretation of this world; in the Main World Prime Universe, they are the rules.

Elemental attacks.

Are rule attacks.

You must understand that for Seventh Rank, Eighth Rank, and even stronger Evolvers, the primary method is to attack by leveraging the power of rules, even the power of the world within an Inner World is made up of many rules’ powers converging.

The same strike, its might could reach ten.

But if it is amplified by rules, its might could possibly reach ten thousand, a hundred thousand.

Being immune to rule attacks, and up to ninety percent of them, directly made Lin Yuan almost unbeatable among Ninth Rank Evolvers.

Unless with external help, which Ninth Rank Evolver could kill Lin Yuan?

Not to mention killing, even inflicting a wound on Lin Yuan was as hard as ascending to heaven, and apart from that, Lin Yuan also had the Blood Rebirth Divine Ability, which allowed any injury to recover instantly.

The rule attacks from which the Elemental Body is immune do not overlap with the effects of Defensive Treasures, meaning both can be used in conjunction.

The most important thing is, this Divine Skill can grow with Lin Yuan’s growth.

When Lin Yuan reaches the Ninth Rank, he can be immune to ninety percent of the might of all rule attacks at the Ninth Layer level.

When Lin Yuan reaches the Tenth Rank, naturally he can also be immune to ninety percent of the might of all rule attacks at the Tenth Layer level.

“Monstrous, this is truly monstrous.”

Lin Yuan inwardly exclaimed, such Divine Skills, coupled with Blood Rebirth, simply amounted to the strongest defensive Divine Skill combination.

Ending today’s cultivation.

Lin Yuan returned to Longshan City.

In the grand hall of the Longshan Family, powerful Knights stood patrolling.

“Patriarch.” Upon seeing Lin Yuan appear, a Knight immediately greeted him with respectful salutation.

In a hundred years, the former Baron Longshan had long passed on the title of Viscount and position of family head to Lin Yuan. Regardless of how much Lin Yuan concealed his strength, he had declared more than eighty years ago that he had entered the Fourth Level, becoming the true top combat power in Longshan Ling and several nearby Viscount territories.

The transition of family power went smoothly, mainly because Lin Yuan’s strength was sufficient; many of the past Viscounts and heads of the Longshan Family didn’t have the power of the Fourth Level before their succession.

It was only after becoming the Patriarch that they borrowed the family’s vast Cultivation Resources to barely step into the Fourth Level.

Lin Yuan, on the other hand, was already at the Fourth Level before succeeding as the Patriarch… Absolute strength, combined with the potential of becoming a Fifth Level Knight, convinced many members of the family.

“Ah Ling, that Cultivation Skill, have you taught it to the family members yet?” Lin Yuan asked softly from the Viscount’s throne.

The ‘Ah Ling’ he spoke of was named Longshan Ling, who had once madly pursued Lin Yuan,

But upon realizing there was little hope, she turned her efforts to the trivial affairs of the Longshan Family and was used greatly by Lin Yuan.

“Patriarch, that Cultivation Skill is very effective; it seems to have no specific bloodline restrictions. Our Longshan Family’s prospective Knights are practicing it, and they have even uncovered Bloodline Powers beyond the ‘Mountain Dragon’ bloodline…”

Longshan Ling’s voice trembled slightly with excitement; she understood all too well what such a Cultivation Skill meant.

Many members of the Longshan Family, despite having the potential to become Knights, couldn’t practice the Longshan Cultivation Skill due to the ‘Mountain Dragon’ bloodline being too weak within them.

But the Martial Tao Cultivation Skill that Lin Yuan gave automatically uncovers the most suitable bloodline rather than being exclusive to the ‘Mountain Dragon’ bloodline.

Once such cultivation skills become widespread, it means that the number of knights of the Longshan Family will surge.

The more knights there are, the stronger the Longshan Family becomes; the stronger the Longshan Family becomes, the more resources they can acquire, which in turn enables them to train even more knights.

This forms a virtuous cycle.

“Since that is the case, let it be disseminated,” Lin Yuan said indifferently.

The Martial Tao Cultivation Skill he had handed to Longshan Ling was precisely the ‘localized’ Martial Path Evolutionary Path.

During this journey, apart from becoming as strong as possible and increasing his power, Lin Yuan naturally did not forget to ‘disseminate’ the Dao.

Before stepping into the realm of Supreme Beings, the ultimate leap requires more lives to cultivate the Martial Dao Cultivation Evolution Path, which would bring greater benefits to Lin Yuan.

The creatures of this world are the sources of worship for the gods, and Lin Yuan wanted a share of that as well.

Anyway, since there is no strict conflict between the two, Lin Yuan does not need the creatures’ worship; he just needs them to cultivate the Martial Dao Evolution Path.

“Disseminate it…” Longshan Ling’s heart trembled; she was well aware of how precious the cultivation skill Lin Yuan had given her was.

Although its dissemination would maximize the strength of the Longshan Family, at the same time, there was no way to prevent the skill from leaking out.

Soon, knights from other territories would also get their hands on this cultivation skill, and the Longshan Family’s advantage would be diminished, even placed on the same starting line.

“Don’t worry, just do as I say, and there won’t be any problems.”

Lin Yuan glanced at Longshan Ling and spoke calmly.

His purpose in localizing the Martial Path Evolutionary Path was to spread it as much as possible in this world, popularize it among the entire Longshan Family, and then have it disseminated further.

As for the Longshan Family becoming indistinguishable from others? With Lin Yuan, the future Viscount Longshan, the glory of the Longshan Family will far exceed Longshan Ling’s imagination.

“And those people from the ‘Lust’ Church, are they still in Longshan City?” Lin Yuan asked about the second matter.

The ‘Lust’ Church is one of the demigod churches that the empire severely cracks down on, which wandered to the vicinity of Anpu City over a hundred years ago.

Original Essence Qi of Longshan Yuan, the former incarnation, was greatly damaged, and it was closely related to the ‘Lust’ Church.

Over the past century, Lin Yuan had largely figured out the ‘Lust’ Church’s goal, which is to secretly control the Longshan Family to quietly collect faith for the ‘Lust’ Mother Goddess behind the scenes.

According to the information Lin Yuan received, the Mother Goddess of Lust is a very powerful demigod who has repeatedly escaped from the clutches of the Main God of Rank’s Church.

Although gods cannot directly interfere with the mortal world, as strong as the Main God of Rank, they can descend through divine incarnations and wield combat power close to that of a True God.

A hundred years ago, the ‘Lust’ Church targeted the original body, Longshan Yuan, but with the Consciousness Descent of Lin Yuan, he immediately returned to Longshan City and had no intention of going back to Anpu City, causing the plans of the ‘Lust’ Church to fall through.

With no other choice, the ‘Lust’ Church could only send people to infiltrate Longshan City to see if they could continue to connect with Longshan Yuan.

Unfortunately, the alluring vixen who infiltrated Longshan City waited for fifty years. After growing old without any allure left, she still did not encounter Lin Yuan.

To be precise, this alluring vixen had seen Lin Yuan up close several times, but Lin Yuan couldn’t be bothered with her.

Fifty years later, the vixen left the scene, aged and diminished, yet the ‘Lust’ Church still did not give up on Longshan Ling and instead sent another young woman.

This time, the Lust Church’s aim was not on Lin Yuan but on the few members next in line for succession in the Longshan Family.

Lin Yuan saw through the ‘Lust’ Church’s intentions at a glance.

For an organization like the Lust Church, which is wanted by the empire, unless absolutely necessary, they would never take action; otherwise, any trace would draw the attention of the Rank Church.

After finding out they could not deal with Lin Yuan, the Lust Church preferred to take more time, planning to outlive Lin Yuan and slowly plot afterward.

“They wish to outlive me?”

A strange look appeared on Lin Yuan’s face; this world’s rules limit even Fourth or Fifth Level knights from living past two hundred years.

In this light, the plans of the Lust Church did not seem so flawed, but that applied only to ordinary Fourth or Fifth Level knights.

As for Lin Yuan? Even without considering his true lifespan, just the time he could stay, he had one thousand one hundred and ten years. Even if the Lust Church could wait, how would they face the fully empowered Lin Yuan capable of slaughtering True Gods in his prime?
